military.t: Pakistan Army Chief Munir ARRIVES IN TEHRAN with US New Message
military.d: Field Marshal Asim Munir landed in Tehran carrying what Iranian state media IRIB describes as a new message from the United States. Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi personally received the Pakistani delegation at Tehran airport. Delegation includes Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, foreign ministry officials, and technical experts. ISPR confirmed this is part of ongoing mediation efforts to end the six-week war. Delegation will outline a plan for a second round of talks. assessment.body:
Day 48 opens with the most significant diplomatic development since Islamabad.

MUNIR IN TEHRAN — THE DECISIVE SIGNAL
• Pakistan Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir arrived in Tehran with a new message from the US
• Iranian FM Araghchi personally received delegation at airport — high-level signal
• Includes Interior Minister Naqvi + technical experts — substantive, not symbolic
• ISPR: part of ongoing mediation efforts. Mission: outline plan for second round of talks
• Simultaneously, PM Sharif in Saudi Arabia — two-pronged Islamabad strategy
• This is the closest thing to a formal second-round invitation yet

IRAN HORMUZ HALT — THE KEY WATCH
• Iran reportedly weighing temporary halt to Hormuz shipments as goodwill gesture
• If confirmed: most significant Iranian concession since ceasefire
• Brent could fall to $80-85 within 48 hours of confirmation
• For India: Brent at $85 = LPG hike risk fully removed, rupee to 91-92, Sensex 80,000+

THE STRUCTURAL PROBLEM — LEBANON
• Iran FM: No deal until Israeli strikes on Lebanon stop
• Israel refuses Lebanon ceasefire. Hezbollah rejects any deal
• Munir delegation includes technical experts — possibly to bridge Lebanon gap
• This is the single biggest structural obstacle to a deal

INDIA MARKET OUTLOOK — TODAY
• S&P 500 at RECORD HIGH overnight — strong global signal
• Sensex at 78,111 — just 578 pts below pre-war 78,699
• Wipro Q4 after market hours today — expected +8.7% YoY, first buyback in 3 years
• India VIX falling fast — fear gauge at pre-war levels
• If Munir visit produces second round announcement: Sensex could cross 79,000-80,000
• If Iran-Lebanon demand blocks progress: flat to mild correction
• If Iran announces temporary Hormuz halt: sharp rally, Brent below $90 within hours

CEASEFIRE EXPIRY: APRIL 22 — 6 DAYS (CORRECTED FROM APR 21)
• Scenario A (~65%): Munir + Saudi talks produce second round this weekend. Ceasefire extended. Brent $75-85, Sensex 80,000-85,000, rupee to 91-92
• Scenario B (~25%): Lebanon blocks deal. Apr 22 ceasefire lapses. Brent $120-130, Nifty could test 22,000
• Scenario C (~10%): Iran announces temporary Hormuz halt today. Immediate market surge. Brent below $85 within 48 hours

VERDICT: This is the inflection point. Munir in Tehran + Iran weighing Hormuz halt + S&P at record = the highest probability window for a deal since the war began. The next 48-72 hours will determine whether India gets the energy relief it needs before April 22.
